security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Records with fields you name, like index cards
bundle.longDescription: ThreeByFive keeps research notes, bibliographies and anything else you would once have kept on index cards, as records with fields you name, each holding text of any length. It can also import databases from Notebook II, the 1980s DOS program.
bundle.copyright: ThreeByFive. Notebook II, whose files it imports, was a product of Pro/Tem Software, Inc.
